events.text: Eleni Theocharous was born in Amiantos.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Theocharous was born in Amiantos on 24 June 1953 .

events.text: Theocharous was elected to the European Parliament.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She was elected to the European Parliament in 2009

events.text: Theocharous was re-elected to the European Parliament.
events.subject: self

events.text: Theocharous began serving as a member of the House of Representatives of Cyprus for the Limassol constituency.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 2001 to 2009 , Theocharous served as a member of the House of Representatives of Cyprus

events.text: Theocharous's service as a member of the House of Representatives of Cyprus ended.
